full_judgment: 14. It will not be out of place to cite another decision with regard to Registration Act, Section 60 of the Registration Act and sections 65(c), 68, 78 and 79 of the Evidence Act, in the case of Aboni Mohan Saha vs Assistant Custodian, Vested Property, Chandpur reported in 39 DLR (AD) 223 wherein it is held that the proof of certified copies and presumption as to genuineness of the same when a certified copy of the document is produced some sanctity of law is attested by the Evidence Act "Section 78 read with section 79 of the Evidence Act provides for the proof of' the certified copies and the presumption as to the genuineness of such certified copies. The plaintiff has given explanation that the original was burnt.
